source_contract.admission_rule: Use all six snapshots frozen in B_SOURCE_MANIFEST. No witness may be added, removed, replaced, or weighted using future information.

baseline_extraction.target: the first fenced json block immediately following the exact heading ## `biome.json` in the immutable snapshot blob
baseline_extraction.parse_rule: strict JSON parse; object-key order and insignificant whitespace are representation only; array order and scalar values are preserved
baseline_extraction.failure: if the block is absent, duplicated, or not strict JSON, the corresponding future consequence is NOT_IDENTIFIED

semantics: Each extracted biome.json is the frozen current configuration witness on which the selected future Biome migration obligation will later be externally exercised.
